title: Homotopy chain representatives of the single-module cover comparison
statement: For arbitrary p:Y→B, g:A→B, opens U,V and a module N on U union V, use the standard derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], canonical single-module base-change maps [def-pc-standard-single-base-change-map] and literal tensor-pullback coefficients [def-pc-module-pullback]. There exist complexes C,D,C′,D′ of module sheaves on A, maps t:C→D, t′:C′→D′, α:C→C′, β:D→D′, and a specified chain homotopy H:t≫β~α≫t′. Six isomorphisms identify the localized first, middle and cone objects with the union, biproduct of members and overlap objects on both sides. Under these isomorphisms Q(α), Q(β), and Q(mappingCone.mapOfHomotopy H) are the canonical union comparison, biproduct of member comparisons and overlap comparison. No strict square or replacement of its middle complex is asserted.

source.place: Tags 08BV, 08HZ, 08FE, 08HY and 0DJ9; the resolved cover-diagram comparison before the cylinder step of new-pc-standard-single-union-ses-chain-data.

proof.text: Set W=U union V and take the inverse images of U and V along W.ι. They cover W by preimage_sup and ι_preimage_self. Apply the resolved relative cover comparison to f=W.ι;p, its chosen cartesian base change, K=N[0], K′=the ordinary tensor pullback single, and φ=picardTermwiseSingleMap. The global arrow is definitionally the standard union map.

Apply the open relative-arrow normalization separately at U, V and U intersection V. Identify the inverse image of the intersection with the intersection of inverse images. Take the biproduct of the first two arrow isomorphisms; its square follows by the two biproduct projections. Compose each of the six vertex isomorphisms with its appropriate projection. Reassociate each component equality and use the commuting square of the corresponding arrow isomorphism. The cone map and its specified H are unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem standardSingle_union_homotopy_chain_data
    {Y B A : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) (g : A ⟶ B) (U V : Y.Opens)
    (N : (U ⊔ V).toScheme.Modules) :
    letI := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    let a := Arrow.mk (standardSingleBaseChangeMap ((U ⊔ V).ι ≫ p) N g)
    let aU := Arrow.mk (standardSingleBaseChangeMap (U.ι ≫ p)
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (Y.homOfLE le_sup_left) N) g)
    let aV := Arrow.mk (standardSingleBaseChangeMap (V.ι ≫ p)
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (Y.homOfLE le_sup_right) N) g)
    let aUV := Arrow.mk (standardSingleBaseChangeMap ((U ⊓ V).ι ≫ p)
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (Y.homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans le_sup_left)) N) g)
    ∃ (C D C' D' : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings A.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
      (t : C ⟶ D) (t' : C' ⟶ D') (α : C ⟶ C') (β : D ⟶ D'),
      ∃ (H : Homotopy (t ≫ β) (α ≫ t'))
        (e₁ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj C ≅ a.left)
        (e₂ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj D ≅ aU.left ⊞ aV.left)
        (e₃ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone t) ≅ aUV.left)
        (e₁' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj C' ≅ a.right)
        (e₂' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj D' ≅ aU.right ⊞ aV.right)
        (e₃' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone t') ≅ aUV.right),
        DerivedCategory.Q.map α ≫ e₁'.hom = e₁.hom ≫ a.hom ∧
        DerivedCategory.Q.map β ≫ e₂'.hom = e₂.hom ≫ biprod.map aU.hom aV.hom ∧
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.mappingCone.mapOfHomotopy H) ≫ e₃'.hom =
          e₃.hom ≫ aUV.hom
